correctness.rationale: Ghomi's Theorem 1.1 supplies the curvature-order-to-reflection implication for each direction. The explicit vector is unit; the product of two generated reflections has rotation angle 2 arccos(1/3), which is an irrational multiple of 2 pi by the rational-algebraic-integer argument. Conjugation and Lie brackets generate so(d), so the closed symmetry group contains O(d). The orthogonal-complement ellipsoid proves sharpness for every list of at most d-1 directions.
